title: Nantou City: Uncovering Shenzhen’s 1,700-Year-Old Secret in the Heart of Modern China
description: Follow in Jianrong Li's footsteps, step into Nantou City, Shenzhen’s ancient core with Ming Dynasty walls and the Wen Ancestral Hall. Discover how this 1,700-year-old treasure coexists with skyscrapers, blending history and modernity. Witness China’s past heroes and future ambitions in one iconic landmark!
